title: Driftwood Dunes Vacation Rental
meta_description: Driftwood Dunes is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionDRIFTWOOD DUNESSeacrest Beach CommunitySeacrest Beach Blvd West, Seacrest Beach, FL 32461New Photos reflect complete Remodel of the home Home Highlights4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms (see “Room Details” tab for full configurations)Sleeps 12 guests2,529 sq. ft.Suite 1: King bed, TV, en-suite bathroom with double sink & walk-in showerSuite 2: King bed, TV, private balcony for two, en-suite bathroom with double vanity, walk-in shower & soaker tubKing Guest Room: TV, shared balcony accessBunk-room: Twin-over-full bunk with trundle, shared balcony accessAdditional 3rd Floor Living Space with Sleeper Sofa (sleeping space does not have a door) and en-suite bathroomTwo additional bathrooms- one with double sinks & a shower and the other a convenient half bathPet-Friendly: 1 pet max, 20 lb limit, $250 non-refundable fee per pet (must be listed on reservation and approved by 30A Cottages)Four adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb bikes not included; additional rentals available)Property OverviewBring the family to Driftwood Dunes, a charming, pet-friendly home in Seacrest Beach. The open-concept great room features a spacious kitchen with oversized island, large dining area, and cozy living space—perfect for gathering with family and friends. French doors lead to airy balconies on the second and third floors. The home offers two large main suites, a bunkroom, and two additional guest rooms for ultimate comfort.Seacrest Beach community amenities include:12,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool with multiple levels, waterfalls, fountains, and bath housesFood provisions at the poolPrivate beach accessCommunity shuttleLocated just steps from Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and 30Avenue, you’ll enjoy high-end dining, luxury shopping, and world-class outdoor experiences.Community AmenitiesComplimentary Beach Tram (March–October) connecting shops, pool, and private beachLargest pool on 30AEasy access to top-rated restaurants and shops in Seacrest, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet BeachGolf carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach CommunityParkingTwo-vehicle driveway at Driftwood DunesOff-street parking available on a first-come, first-served basis; must be in designated lined spaces with valid parking permitNo trailers allowedViolations enforced by Seacrest Property Owners Association; 30A Cottages not responsible for fines or towingBooking & PoliciesNo smokingPublished rates do not include tax and fees50% due at booking; balance due 30 days before arrival (or in full if booking within 30 days)Optional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment)Check-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 10:00 AM (CST) Minimum age to rent: 25 yearsCancellations: Initial 50% fully refundable if canceled more than 30 days before arrival, minus 5% processing fee
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor Bunk Room: Trundle Bed, Bunk Beds (1 Twin & 1 Full)
3rd Floor Living Area: Sofa Sleeper (Queen/Full) - Sleeper Sofa (There is not a door on this area)
